title: Eighteenth-Century Music and theatre advertisements from the 's-Gravenhaagsche Courant and Gazette de La Haye (in the Netherlands)
descriptions: Extensive excerpting of 's Gravenhaagse Courant and Gazette de La Haye 1750-1795 with additional data from 1725 on concerning Theater and Music (theatrical representations, concerts, editions of plays and music) and misc.

History of files and advice on usage of these data: - You need the program FileMaker Pro to open this database. - Due to problems opening the fp7-file in Original, DANS converted it to a fmp12-version and uploaded this file into this dataset. Please see the folder 'Processed' for the file. No description of the metadata field; should speak for itself. If not, please contact depositor. Explanation on the main screen. Geen aparte veldbeschrijving toegevoegd: spreekt voor zich (zo niet hoor ik het graag), toelichting op het hoofdscherm
